name: inquiry
description: Find outside evidence and shape uncertain ideas into judgeable next steps without imposing a fixed workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Search outward and shape what matters next
interface.longDescription: Inquiry helps Codex investigate outside facts and possibilities, expose consequential assumptions, and make uncertain directions easier to judge. Search and Shape are independent skills rather than stages in a mandatory process; they return discoveries and clarified decisions to the work already in progress.
defaultPrompt: Find outside evidence or references that could change this decision.
Make the most consequential uncertainty in this idea easier to judge.
Explore a more interesting direction without turning it into a fixed workflow.
